positioning.heading: The originator, *not an instructor.*
paragraphs: Every field has its teachers, and then it has its source. Dr Sherif Wakil created The O Concept™, brought the O-Shot® and P-Shot® to the United Kingdom, and has more than 25,000 cases worldwide. When physicians train with him, they are not learning a version of the protocol — they are learning the protocol, from the person who wrote it.

As an international trainer and speaker, Dr Wakil has taught these techniques to doctors across Europe, the Middle East and beyond. The training fellowship formalises that teaching into a structured pathway for medical professionals.

steps.title: Masterclasses
steps.text: Intensive, small-group teaching in the theory and evidence behind The O Concept™ — vascular, hormonal and regenerative medicine as one integrated discipline.

steps.title: Hands-on Harley Street Training
steps.text: Supervised clinical training at 77 Harley Street, working alongside Dr Wakil and his team on the exact techniques he introduced to the UK — O-Shot®, P-Shot®, energy-based devices and combination protocols.

steps.title: Certification
steps.text: Assessed certification in The O Concept™ protocol, with ongoing mentorship, case review and access to the IAAGSW professional community after graduation.

fellowship.note: Cohort sizes are deliberately small · Applications reviewed personally by Dr Wakil

iaagsw.heading: IAAGSW
iaagsw.tagline: The International Association of Aesthetic Gynaecology and Sexual Well-being.
paragraphs: Founded and presided over by Dr Wakil, the IAAGSW is the global professional body for aesthetic gynaecology and sexual-wellbeing medicine — setting standards, connecting practitioners across continents, and giving a young field the scientific rigour and ethical framework it needs to mature.
Fellowship graduates join a worldwide community of IAAGSW practitioners: shared case forums, annual scientific meetings, and a professional standard patients can trust wherever they are treated.
